questions.stem: A platform consists of a major sector of radius $r$ cm and angle $2\pi-\theta$, joined to a minor sector of radius $2r$ cm and angle $\theta$, where $r>0$ and $0<\theta<\pi$. Their centres are both $O$ and the two radial directions are common. The two sectors have disjoint interiors. The longer-radius arc has length $4\pi$ cm and the total area is $54\pi\text{ cm}^2$.

parts.text: Find $r$ and $\theta$, giving exact answers.
solutionSteps: 长半径的弧满足 $2r\theta=4\pi$，即 $r\theta=2\pi$。
两部分面积相加：$54\pi=\frac12r^2(2\pi-\theta)+\frac12(2r)^2\theta=\pi r^2+\frac32r^2\theta$。
负半径舍去；$r=6$，继而 $\theta=\pi/3$，确在指定范围。

parts.text: Determine $n$ and $\alpha$. Explain why your values describe a valid fan.
solutionSteps: 利用 $n\beta=2\pi-n\alpha$，面积方程为 $2n\alpha+32n\beta=64\pi-90$，故 $n\alpha=3$。

代入 $n\alpha=3$ 及给定周界，得 $n=4$，$\alpha=3/4$。
验证 $n$ 为正整数且 $\beta=\pi/2-3/4>0$，整周角条件确实满足。

questions.stem: An annular sector has inner radius $r$ cm, outer radius $2r$ cm and angle $\theta$ radians. Its area is $24\text{ cm}^2$ and its complete perimeter is $22$ cm.

parts.text: Show that $r^2-11r+24=0$.

$48/r+2r=22$，整理得 $r^2-11r+24=0$。
